summary: @servicetitan/startup-utils preinstall downloads Bun runtime and executes bundled obfuscated payload
details: The package declares scripts.preinstall = "node setup.mjs". setup.mjs downloads the Bun runtime (bun-v1.3.13) from the oven-sh/bun releases, extracts and chmods the binary, then execFileSyncs it against a sibling file math_init.js. math_init.js is a 727 KB Bun-CJS bundle whose top-level constants form a shuffled mixed-value dispatch array paired with a shift-decoder function (classic string-array obfuscator output). setup.mjs itself uses obfuscator-style _0xNNNN identifiers and indirection objects to hide plain string constants such as paths, commands, and URLs. The package's stated purpose is trivial version-mismatch utilities (dist/index.js re-exports two helpers) and does not require a second language runtime or a large opaque bundle. The Bun runtime fetch is the delivery mechanism for executing an obfuscated, package-shipped blob under an alternate runtime at npm install time, evading Node-based inspection.

cwes.description: The product contains code that appears to be malicious in nature.
cwes.name: Embedded Malicious Code
